description: This file is a C# source code file implementing an ASP.NET Core MVC controller named ManageController. It provides various user account management functionalities such as viewing and updating user profile information, changing or setting passwords, managing external login providers, and handling Two-Factor Authentication setup and recovery codes.

classes.name: ManageController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC Controller managing user profile, password, external logins, and Two-Factor Authentication functionalities.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests; retrieves and displays current user's profile information.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests; updates user's email and phone number based on submitted form.

methods.name: SendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Generates email confirmation token and sends verification email to the user.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Handles GET requests; displays change password form if user has a password.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Handles POST requests; processes password change for the user.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: Handles GET requests; displays form to set a new password if user doesn't have one.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: Handles POST requests; sets a new password for the user.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Displays external login providers linked to the user account.

methods.name: LinkLogin
methods.description: Initiates linking an external login provider to the user account.

methods.name: LinkLoginCallback
methods.description: Handles callback from external login provider to link login info.

methods.name: RemoveLogin
methods.description: Removes an external login provider from the user account.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Displays Two-Factor Authentication status and options.

methods.name: Disable2faWarning
methods.description: Shows a warning before disabling 2FA.

methods.name: Disable2fa
methods.description: Disables Two-Factor Authentication for the user.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Displays form to enable authenticator app 2FA.

methods.name: ShowRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Displays 2FA recovery codes.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticatorWarning
methods.description: Shows warning before resetting authenticator app key.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticator
methods.description: Resets and generates new authenticator app key.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Generates new 2FA recovery codes.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodesWarning
methods.description: Shows warning before generating new recovery codes.
